news.title: Anthropic confidentially files IPO prospectus with SEC, prepping Wall Street for landmark AI deal
news.detail: Anthropic said it confidentially filed its IPO prospectus with the SEC, setting up a potentially historic share sale for investors ready to jump into AI.

news.title: S&P 500 closes at a record to kick off June trading as tech rally overpowers oil spike: Live updates
news.detail: The S&P 500 rose on Monday, even as oil prices advanced, with Nvidia leading technology higher following the launch of a new chip for PCs.

news.title: SpaceX sets aside up to 5% of shares in IPO for certain employees and friends
news.detail: In an updated IPO prospectus, SpaceX said that up to 5% of stock being offered by the company in the offering will be available in a direct share program.

news.title: Quantinuum上调IPO规模至14.6亿美元，估值剑指143亿美元
news.detail: 量子计算公司Quantinuum周一宣布上调首次公开募股规模，将发行股数增加至2650万股，发行价区间提高至每股53至55美元，最高募资额达14.6亿美元。

news.title: SpaceX预留5% IPO股份，目标估值1.8万亿美元
news.detail: SpaceX在周一提交的修订版IPO申报文件中首次明确，将在即将进行的首次公开募股中预留最多5%的A类普通股，供部分员工及高管亲友认购。该公司目标估值至少为1.8万亿美元。

news.title: Microsoft and Google are late to AI coding, but 'absolutely critical' they compete for growth
news.detail: Coding tools are becoming an increasingly big target for Google and Microsoft as they try to catch up to Anthropic and OpenAI.

news.detail: Anthropic周一表示，已向监管机构秘密提交了首次公开募股招股说明书，这是这家人工智能初创公司走向上市的重要一步。 Anthropic在一份声明中表示：“这让我们在美国证券交易...

news.title: SpaceX在IPO中为部分员工及亲友预留高达5%的股份
news.detail: 根据周一发布的一份修订版申报文件，SpaceX已在其首次公开募股（IPO）发售的股票中，预留了最高5%的股份供“特定员工及相关人士”通过直接股票认购计划进行购买。

news.title: These top dividend stocks can help ride out market volatility, investor says
news.detail: ClearBridge Investments' Michael Clarfeld recently bought three names he said are underappreciated right now — and they have solid dividends.
